title: Restart sensor and preemptive restarts option no longer works with new transmitter SN 81xxxx
body: I received a new transmitter and now with the preemptive session restart set I keep getting errors. "Native Sensor is now Stopped: Sensor Failed Start" then " Native sensor is now marked FAILED: Sensor Failed Start" then "Session Start Failed: Invalid". It has been working on the last two transmitters that started with SN 80xxxx, but on the new one stating with SN 81xxxx is when i started getting these errors. Seems the only way to restart the sensor was to start it using the dexcom receiver and then i get the "Warming up" message on both xdrip and dexcom and have to wait the two hour warm up.

comments.body: I am using a G6 transmitter with serial number: 815UKC and firmware 1.6.5.25 and preemptive restarts are working with a nightly build (can't find the exact version).
Mine Says firmware version 1.6.5.27 and is 81CYXX im on alpha version 2019.08.20.. you can see the version under the classic status page in system status

I am using 33fe112-2019.08.19 xDrip. It says my code is: 1908191229 which is downgradable to 1603091400. I did encounter a similar problem back in July. Since I don't care about my security settings here is my XDrip QR code with settings that work for me: xdpref:eJwtjEEOwiAQAP+yZw/dLgjxhkC/QVjZGmLjwdIYa/y7JHqdycwbnnXPj5K2rRY4gZmLMUUzXkjUKIaZM4rYPLMQDgQHyMuSVmmt3q9r+tU9bN38Vzd5dXB0KmL0ypNz1tkhhvM4kdeBFAbnNXy+15kmCA== .

My sensor is 81F6XX firmware 1.6.5.27 and restarts are not working anymore either. I'm currently on build ff2c822-2019.09.24

I uploaded logs as well.

We got transmitter 81A*** to show "please wait for warm up" message, but a
few seconds later, it popped up and said G6 sensor failed.  It still
counted down the warm up, and then began prompting for calibrations!  It
wouldn't get passed that.  So, we had to go to the official Dexcom app to
start it, which it did just fine.  Xdrip nightly 9-30 and alpha release
didn't have an effect.

Using G6 with Nightly transmitter 815LPP. Preemptive restart says "not capable."  Transmitter is on day 17. Not sure how to restart sensor in 2 days.

If you are getting not capable, you may have to manually restart and go through another warm up period. You may try disabling the advanced time travel features. If you have the official Dexcom receiver, you can probably trick it into restarting with the Faraday cage trick. What is on the first page of the status screen (the one with version information)?

What is the Faraday cage trick?
